content.text: The City of New Castle Board of Health needs your help! The City of New Castle Board of Health needs your help! We’d like to know more about what health-related topics are of interest to our community members. A survey to help us better understand your needs will be posted on the City website during the month of April and we would greatly appreciate it if our neighbors would take the couple of minutes (it’s very short!) to complete this survey. Also, please encourage others in your household to do the same – the more people of various ages who do this survey, the more complete our picture of what New Castilians want will be. IF you complete paper survey at the City Health Fair in October of 2025, please don’t complete the electronic one as the information is the same and your responses have been recorded. Thanks so much for your help! The survey can be accessed directly at: [...]Learn More Experience The City of New Castle Living in New Castle New Castle is great place to live, work and play. New Castle is known for its thriving historic downtown, outdoor open spaces and recreation including Battery Park, multiple playgrounds, trails, nature areas, tennis courts, sailing club, library and museums. View More Visiting New Castle Historic New Castle, Delaware is located just 10 minutes south of downtown Wilmington with easy access from I-95 and I-295. Overlooking the Delaware River, Historic New Castle is the oldest continuously occupied town in the Delaware Valley. View More Business in New Castle New Castle is a business-friendly City with expedited permitting, community policing and competitive, reliable electric and water service.
